pages.text: The bony sorcerer-king in his black castle. His blow withers, and wounded, he raises upyri from the earth.
Koschei cannot be killed: he gets up again. His death is at the tip of a needle, the needle in an egg, the egg in a chest on an old oak. Find Koschei's oak.
Break the egg (right-click) and carry the needle. Then the last blow kills Koschei, and the needle breaks. He drops the cap of invisibility.
